title: 'JaredfromSubway' bot front runs Vitalik Buterin's $4 token swap with $1 million in volume
summary: The Ethereum co-founder, who has spent months campaigning against toxic MEV with proposals for encrypted mempools, just had one of his own swaps front-run and back-run by the network's most notorious sandwich bot.

title: Bitcoin lenders say institutions want crypto credit to look more like TradFi
summary: At Consensus 2026 in Miami, executives from Two Prime, Ledn and Lygos Finance said institutional borrowers increasingly prioritize custody, transparency and standardized lending structures over complex DeFi products after the crypto credit collapses of 2022.
